promotion_policy.rule_1: A Challenger may learn from completed experiences.
promotion_policy.rule_2: A Challenger may never promote itself.
promotion_policy.rule_4: The Challenger must survive rolling out-of-sample testing.
promotion_policy.rule_5: The Challenger must then survive fresh paper validation.
promotion_policy.rule_6: Risk-adjusted performance must improve without unacceptable drawdown.
promotion_policy.rule_7: Only after every promotion gate passes may the Challenger replace the Champion.
